description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Ice], [Damage Cap +10000], and [Chilling Lash Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ice
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Chilling Lash Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Chilling Lash after using two Ice abilities

description.name: Chilling Lash
description.text: Causes [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)] and [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], removes positive effects
